name: Brake out with Pad FX
lesson:
## Power-off, then the new one

Pad FX A6 set to Braker. Press it on beat 4 of bar 12 so A slows to a stop across that beat; on the one of bar 13 pull A's fader, play B and bring its fader up. Everything after the brake happens on the downbeat.

A brake is a full stop, so unlike an echo out there is no tail to hide the incoming track under: B has to land exactly on the one or the room hears the gap. This is the most common way out of a track in hip-hop sets because it works at any tempo and needs no beatmatching.
